source:
The protagonist, Vladislav, once got lost in an apartment (albeit not his own), which is already quite enough to understand the situation. Now imagine what happened to him when he got out onto the street.

But our story begins several years after this incident, with one extraordinary conversation.
Miraculously not missing a strange bus, our protagonist ultimately ends up in an equally strange "pioneer" camp.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2901754571]Steam[/url]]
